description:
This is the final run of the Evasion lite. What we have is what we got, we will not be getting any other colors, and we do not have any of the previous colors left.

The Evasion Lite is just that, a stripped back version of the original Evasion. Ideal if you're looking for a bike with the geometry and tire clearances of the Evasion, but don't need all of the rack mounts and what not, for the heavy duty off-road touring it's designed to do. The Evasion Lite features the Crust Carbon Fork in another effort to keep the weight down.

Pair one of these up with a tire like the 27.5x2.8" Schwalbe G-One All Around for maximum speed to volume ratio as proven by science.

We DO NOT condone the use of a front rack on our carbon forks. Would it be totally fine? Maybe? Can we afford the law suit when your fork breaks and you go from "Ah nah man I'm chill, even if something happens it'll be on me." to "Those *#&!@*$% it's all their fault, they'll PAY!", no we cannot. So please, use some common sense here.

700c x 55. We tested with a Rene Herse Antelope Hill on the rear and a Fleecer Ridge on the front. Both mounted to Velocity SS blunts. This combo raises the BB height around 5mm then is listed on the chart, putting it at 295mm.

27.5 X 2.8. We tried 27.5 Schwalbe G-Ones. Rear tire was mounted to a Stans Sentry rim and the front an Enve G27. This combo also put the BB at 295mm in height. Please note more aggressive 2.8s would potentially not fit.

26 x 3.0 fits in the front and 26 x 2.8 is the max for the rear. This combo put the BB at 285mm

73mm BB shell so it takes a MOUNTAIN crank. Ideally 1x with a maximum ~40 tooth chainring. You can set it up 2x, for all double set up configurations please contact Zach at bike insights. Rear end spacing is NOT BOOST it will take a regular non-boost ring.

Fork is a non-tapered steerer 1 1/8" Crust Carbon Fork with internal dynamo and brake cable routing.

Fixed 142mm X 12mm rear dropouts. No rocker dropouts on this one, in efforts to shave weight.

Front and rear thru axles are included.

The steel plate on the drive side has been axed, you guessed it, save weight.

Integrated headset cups. Takes a Chris King Dropset 4 or any BMX integrated headset. Upper and lower bearing dimensions are 42mm with a 45 degree taper. Check out Empire BMX for BMX headsets.

Flat mount front and rear. If you need a brake kit we've got Palm Oils for the Evasion Lite.

All sizes up to the Large have 28.6 D.T and TT, the Large and Xtra-Large have a 28.6 TT and a 31.8 DT. All sizes are heat treated CR-MO

Fender mounts are there. Rear rack mounts are not.

Takes a 30.0mm seat post clamp with a 27.2 seat post.

If you need a seat post clamp we have some HERE!

HEADSET NOT INCLUDED

ED Coated to help protect it from the elements and inhibit internal corrosion. This doesn't mean you're free to ride it into the ocean though.

Handmade in Taiwan using Heat Treated Chromoly

Tig Welded
